title: A bit disappointed with the Non-stick etc.
text:
A bit disappointed with the Non-stick etc.. This looks good, but it does not feel or look like the steamer basket is Stainless, like my Farberware one is.
I would have like this much better if it was All stainless on the inside, instead of that regular Non-stick in the bottom of the
larger pot.
Since the bottom of the larger pot is the regular non-stick, and does not say it is BPA, or PFOA Free!.
I will not be using it to cook in.
It does say it is Porcelain Enamel which I think is very misleading, as its only Enamel on the outside..This pot would be a healthier and last longer if the pot was Enamel on the inside.

It is a nice color red, with the Red easy grip handles on the lid, and on each of the pots, and do not get real hot. But I still use pot holders.

Being that this is not real big. I found it is big enough for a family of 4 to steam corn, srtring-beans, potatoes, or any vegetable you want to steam.
You can also use the water dripping from your veggies to use for a soup etc., or freeze it for next time, it has healthy nutrients in it.

I do have a larger Steamer pot, but this size is my go to steamer pot size for everyday.
It is healthier to steam then use a microwave, as that takes allot of the enzymes out of your food..

Since Rachael Ray's other cookware, and stoneware is made in China, I'm guess this is also!..
I think $50.00 is pricy for Rachael's pot.

Rachael Ray needs to start making some healthy cookware, that is BPA, & PFOA Free. Also her line of Stoneware should be Cadmium & Lead free also.

I have to say, I love using a steamer pot for my veggies..Although not so happy with this onel
That said, this one will do the job of steaming and you do not need allot of water at the bottom.

product_metadata.title: Rachael Ray Brights Sauce Pot/Saucepot with Steamer Insert, 3 Quart, Orange Gradient
features: CONVENIENT MULTI POT: Make soups and stews with this nonstick saucepot or add the steamer basket for seafood, pasta, or corn on the cob
MADE TO LAST: Durable aluminum saucepot with steam basket heats quickly and evenly for convenient cooking
EASY DOES IT: Long-lasting nonstick easily releases foods for stovetop convenience and fast cleanup
GET A GRIP: Grippy handles are comfortable to grasp and double riveted for extra strength when using the steamer set as a pasta pot or lobster pot
OVEN LOVIN': Oven safe to 350°F, this saucepot and steamer combo is a great addition for versatility in your kitchen
SET INCLUDES: 3-Quart Saucepot, Stainless Steel Steamer Insert and Lid
description: Steam your way to meal time success with this multipurpose steamer set. Vegetables, dumplings and tamales steam to perfection in no time and the steamer insert makes it a cinch to boil and strain pasta for a delicious spaghetti dinner. The saucepot is perfect on its own for making stews, soups, and sauces, too. High-quality nonstick for easy food release and fast cleanup. Oven safe to 350°F.
